diagnosis: The Agent quoted '[ROUND END] markers' inside working-memory prose. The Harbor adapter used grep -Fq and treated that substring as the exact completion sentinel, then terminated the still-running GA process.
remediation: Require an exact full-line sentinel with grep -Fxq; rerun both paired conditions under a new immutable suffix.
result_use: Infrastructure diagnosis only; exclude reward, trajectory length, and task outcome from candidate comparison.
